_note: Hand-edited. Commit after each update. China M2: monthly, PBoC ~14th. CB gold/COFER/AI: quarterly. ETF flows: weekly when possible.

scenario.notes: Base case for now: tight policy for longer (40%). Alternatives: markets reconnect with liquidity (30%), a credit scare forces easier policy (20%), or a geopolitics shock (10%).

waypoints.label: BTC $53k floor and gold $4k line still hold

regime_bullets: Hawkish talk from the Fed — money supply still growing
Hard assets near structural floors, far from cycle highs
Four watchpoints under stress · none broken yet

china_m2.source: PBoC monthly release; June figure due ~14 Jul 2026

global_m2_yoy_estimate.note: Hand estimate for overall money growth until we have a full year of history on this dashboard.

bloc_m2_yoy.note: Year-over-year money growth in local currency. Eurozone and Japan are midpoints of published ranges.
bloc_m2_yoy.source: Official releases / mid-2026 compile (see Notes on Global M2)

divergence.note: Since mid-2025, Bitcoin has not been tracking global money growth the way it used to. Timer resets when they move together again.

cb_gold.note: Central banks are still net buyers. China has bought for 20 months in a row. That is the floor — markets still set the day-to-day gold price.

cofer_usd_share.note: Q1 2026 was the first quarter the dollar’s share of reserves ticked up after a long decline.

ai_transition.crossover_status: Oracle already spends more than it earns from operations; Amazon is getting close. Big cloud/AI spenders as a group may tip that way around Q3 2026.
ai_transition.structural_slopes: Running AI models is getting much cheaper (cost roughly halves every ~2 months). Training efficiency is also rising ~3× per year.
ai_transition.next_test: Big tech earnings in early August 2026

etf_flows.note: Spot BTC ETF flows still net selling — short-run path still fighting broad money growth.

gold_monthly_close.notes: June 2026 monthly close was $4,015.51 — only $15 above the $4,000 line.

cofer_reversal.notes: One up quarter so far; need four in a row to call a real reversal.

ai_financing.notes: Credit spreads are calm (~2.7%). Watch Q3 spending vs cash flow and big tech bond sales.
